headline_pre: Why Every LLM Server Needs a
before_points: Re-reads the whole prompt for every new token
Cost grows with the square of context length
Token 1 and token 500 cost the same
after_points: Keys/values from past tokens are stored, not recomputed
Each new token is one small step of work
This is why chat feels instant after the first token
takeaway: The first token is slow because it builds the cache. Every token after is nearly free.
